subject: Solution Accelerator publish checklist + metering questions
messages:
From: Sarah Hughes <sarah.hughes@cloudforge.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Solution accelerator publish checklist + initial metering questions

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for taking time this morning. CloudForge is excited to list our ‘DataOps Accelerator for LLMs’ on AWS/GCP marketplaces and align on co-sell motion with Redwood. To make the publisher submission smooth, we wanted to confirm a few items where Redwood has precedent: 

- Marketplace manifest: do you prefer a specific field to denote Redwood as an "integration partner" (vs. pure ISV)?
- Metering: we currently expose two SKUs (per-session, per-embedding). How does Redwood want those mapped into your pricing/usage visibility for co-sell reporting?
- Evidence pack: SOC2 excerpt, architecture diagram (redacted), and a short 2-minute demo video — acceptable formats?

Attached: cloudforge_marketplace_manifest.yml (draft), meter_map_v1.csv.

Can we get a short checklist from Redwood for publisher readiness (technical evidence, billing mapping, legal certs) and an expected publish window if we turn things around within 5 business days?

Best,
Sarah Hughes
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge Solutions
[sarah.hughes@cloudforge.com]

[Attachment: cloudforge_marketplace_manifest.yml (yaml)]
[Attachment: meter_map_v1.csv (csv)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hughes <sarah.hughes@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solution accelerator publish checklist + initial metering questions

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the draft. Short answers up front, then a quick checklist and owners: 

- Integration type: we recommend using "Redwood Verified Integration" in the manifest's partner_type field so marketplace reviewers and our co-sell ops recognize the tie-in.
- Metering mapping: we need SKU -> Redwood unit mapping to align with our reporting. Prefer a CSV with columns: partner_sku, partner_meter_type, recommended_redwood_unit (token/session/embedding), example_monthly_volume. Your meter_map_v1.csv is a great start — Ben, can you validate the mapping?
- Evidence formats: PDF for SOC2 snippets, SVG/PNG for diagrams, MP4 under 100MB for demo videos.

Checklist (high level):
1) Technical: manifest + runtime footprint (gpu/cpu), single-tenant vs multi-tenant, network egress profile (Marissa)
2) Security: SOC2 excerpt + data flow diagram + KMS/HSM compatibility note (Marissa)
3) Billing: SKU mapping CSV + list price suggestions + trial entitlements (Ben)
4) Legal/commercial: reseller terms + any partner discount tiers + contact for MSA redlines (Aisha)

Owners: Marissa will own security/technical evidence intake, Ben will own billing mapping and sandbox test, I’ll coordinate legal/commercial artifacts. If you can drop the updated files into the Drive folder (link below) and ping us when ready, we’ll triage and give a publish estimate.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-marketplace-evidence

Estimated publish window: 7-10 business days after we receive completed artifacts and sign-off on the manifest + meter mapping (assuming no legal redlines). If you need co-sell enablement sooner we can prioritize the AWS listing and do GCP in parallel but that may add 2-3 days to ops.

Thanks — we’ll review the attached CSV shortly.

—Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

[Internal note: looping in Ben and Marissa for action items]

From: Sarah Hughes <sarah.hughes@cloudforge.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solution accelerator publish checklist + initial metering questions

Thanks Aisha — quick update and answers inline.

- Updated manifest attached; added partner_type: Redwood Verified Integration.
- Metering: expanded CSV to include example_monthly_volume and partner_trial_units. We included a third SKU for a developer sandbox bundle.
- Evidence: attached SOC2 excerpt (redacted), architecture_diagram.png, and a 90s demo clip (screenshot attached as preview).

Questions for Redwood:
1) For co-sell attribution, will Redwood surface partner referrals in the AWS listing metadata or do you rely solely on internal CRM mapping?
2) For the dev bundle SKU, can Redwood support a 30-day free trial mapping to "trial_units" in your billing so usage during trial does not generate invoices?

Files uploaded to Drive and linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-marketplace-evidence (same folder)

Thanks,
Sarah

[Attachments: architecture_diagram.png, demo_preview.png, cloudforge_soc2_excerpt.pdf, meter_map_v1_rev2.csv]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hughes <sarah.hughes@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solution accelerator publish checklist + initial metering questions

Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround, the artifacts look good. A couple of technical/pricing clarifications from my side before we lock mapping: 

- Per-session vs per-embedding: Are "sessions" stateful conversational contexts (with KV cache retention) and priced by average tokens/session? If yes, please provide a sample session length distribution (p50/p90 tokens). I need that to recommend Redwood unit mapping (we prefer token-based units for consistency).
- Developer sandbox SKU: we can map it to a Redwood "trial_units" entitlement. I just need a flag in the CSV with partner_sku,type=trial so our billing pipeline treats it specially.
- Sandbox listing: can you share a sandbox listing account or a staging API key we can hit to validate metering signals? Preferably with 1000 sample events.

If you can provide the session distribution and add the trial flag to the CSV, I’ll run the mapping and return a proposed table with Redwood unit ids and estimated monthly cost delta.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

[Internal: Marissa — security signoff still needed for KMS note before publish]

From: Sarah Hughes <sarah.hughes@cloudforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solution accelerator publish checklist + initial metering questions

Ben/Aisha — thanks. Answers below and next steps: 

- Sessions: yes, sessions are conversational contexts. We've attached a small sample CSV (session_samples.csv) showing p50=1,200 tokens, p90=4,800 tokens. We can also provide anonymized token logs if helpful.
- Trial flag: updated meter_map_v1_rev3.csv includes partner_sku,type=trial for the dev bundle.
- Sandbox account: created a staging API key (stg_live_4xJk) that you can use for 1,000 validation calls. I’ve added the key to the shared Drive in a password-protected text file and shared access with the emails on this thread.

Next steps agreed:
1) Ben will run mapping and send proposed Redwood unit table by EOD Monday (15 Feb).
2) Marissa to confirm KMS/HSM compatibility and whether any extra evidence is necessary.
3) Aisha to coordinate legal MSA redline window; if none, we’ll aim to submit publisher package by close of week.
4) Scheduled co-sell readiness call: Mon, Feb 15, 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite to follow.

Drive (staging creds + artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-marketplace-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/CF-2027-1152

Cheers,
Sarah Hughes
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge Solutions
